title: Senior App Developer/Mobile Architect Lead - iOS/Android Platform
description:
Sr. App Developer (Android/ iOS / Hybrid)/ Mobile Architect Lead- Global Digital Health Startup.

We are looking for a strong experienced Android engineer, very strong at Coding, and bug fixing for Mobile app development from scratch and who should have worked in an early-stage tech start-up with highly scalable Tech Product development.

Responsibility & Role :

- Coding Android/iOS/Hybrid Mobile applications.

- To Work in close coordination with all stakeholders of Product Owner, Solution Architect, Engineering Head, UX/UI designer, Fullstack Developer, and the testing to develop better products with fewer bugs.

- To work with different APIs and data sources.

- Fix bugs.

- Continuous evaluation, discovering new technologies and exploiting them for the cross-functional platform.

- Android developer's role in multi-function mobile applications.

Required Skillsets :

- Strong hands-on end-to-end in Kotlin, Java.

- Strong knowledge of Android SDK, different versions of Android, and how to deal with different screen sizes

- Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect Android applications to back-end services

- Strong knowledge of Android / iOS / Hybrid / Flutter principles, patterns, and best practices.

- Android Studio. 

- Ability to understand and integrate with 3rd Party Application API.

- Familiarity with cloud message APIs, client engagement, AI chatbot and push notifications features.

- A knack for benchmarking and optimization.

- Understanding of Google's Android principles and interface guidelines.

- Familiarity with continuous integration.

Experience :

- At least 2 -10 Years of experience post-qualification in an early-stage growing startup in any industry, preferably in Digital Health.

- Must have worked in a mobile app product development in an early-stage startup from scratch, especially in a founding team.

- Worked as a single-handed end-to-end from scratch in the Mobile App Development in Highly Scalable Andriod / iOS / Hybrid / Flutter Platform.

Qualification : 

B.Tech in CSE / IT / ECE from a reputed engineering Institute.

CTC :

- Best Package in Industry depending upon our Unbiased Parametric Selection Procedure Criteria and what you bring to the table with written acceptance and written commitment deliverable within Tight Deadlines.

- Terms and Conditions Apply as per our organization.

- To deserving eligible candidates only, the company's attractive ESOP may be given also as a part of a CTC Package for a long-term career Growth opportunity.

- Positions & CTC depend upon your candidature and as per our management Terms.

- Apply with your CV with passport size photo and current CTC, expected CTC, Notice Period, recent Project details, and cover letter.

- This is a high-growth career opportunity that is only best for those who have the capability to fast grow the organization as a High growth driver and with an Entrepreneur Mindset.
